# Left ear investigation

**Summary.** Muffled hearing in the left ear since about September 2026, with intermittent fullness. Referred by the family physician, seen by ENT on 2026-10-12: impression "Left-sided hearing loss, likely conductive", cause not yet established (the note names cerumen impaction or middle ear effusion as possibilities). Hearing test done 2026-11-18; results expected in about two weeks, then a follow-up ENT visit. On 2026-11-18 the owner said the problem is sorted: "it was wax, cleared at the clinic."

**Care team:** [Dr. A. Example](../patient/care-team/prac-example-ent.md) (ENT, [Example ENT Clinic](../patient/care-team/org-example-ent-clinic.md)) · [Dr. B. Familydoc](../patient/care-team/prac-familydoc-family.md) (family physician, referred)
